page.overview:
Who is Nogogglesible?

Nolan Grayson (father) Debbie Grayson (mother)|allies=Angstrom Levy|age=19|born=Thragg Era January 22nd, 2005 Earth}}

Nogogglesible is a supporting antagonist in Invincible, debuting in Season 3. He is an alternate, evil variant of Invincible from another universe.

Nogogglesible was recruited by Angstrom Levy to participate in the Invincible War in the main dimension. After defeating the Guardians, he was taken by surprise by Darkwing II and was subsequently sent into the Shadow-Verse alongside him.

Nogogglesible has nearly identical physique to his original counterpart. He is tall and fair-skinned, with black hair styled into a widow’s peak, combed back with a few strands sticking up, and brown eyes.
